experimental_design: LINC01198 RNA pulldown vs EGFP RNA control

The specific binding proteins of LINC01198 was identified using high-performance liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry (HPLC-MS). Among the identified proteins, TAOK1 and TAOK2 were found to be associated with LINC01198 using EGFP RNA as negative control
factor_value: associated with LINC01198 using EGFP RNA as negative control
